units.source_text: 蹴鞠原是一种不甚文雅而近于粗暴的游戏，但也因地点和人物而异。

en.t: Kemari was originally a rather inelegant and somewhat rough game, though its character changed with the place and the people involved.

units.source_text: 这六条院的优美的庭园中，嘉木葱茏，春云叆叇，樱花处处吐艳、柳梢略带鹅黄之际，即使这种游戏鄙不足道，诸人也都力争胜负，竞夸才能，各不相让。

en.t: Yet in the beautiful gardens of the Rokujo estate, where fine trees grew lush, spring clouds drifted thickly, cherry blossoms bloomed everywhere, and the willow tips were faintly yellow-green, even such a trivial game made everyone strive to win, show off their skill, and yield to no one.

units.source_text: 柏木卫门督率然地参与竞赛，竟无人能战胜他。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, joined the contest on impulse, and no one could defeat him.

units.source_text: 此人相貌清丽，姿态秀美，举止行动，十分矜重，虽然奔走追逐，态度亦甚优雅。

en.t: He had a clear and handsome face, a graceful figure, and a dignified manner; even as he ran and chased after the ball, his bearing remained elegant.

units.source_text: 诸人争球，奔集阶前樱花阴下，热衷于竞赛，把樱花都忘记了。

en.t: As the players fought for the ball and rushed together beneath the cherry shade before the steps, they became so absorbed in the contest that they forgot the blossoms entirely.

units.source_text: 源氏与萤兵部卿亲王都走到栏杆角上来观看。

en.t: Genji and Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, both came out to the corner of the railing to watch.

units.source_text: 诸人竞献绝技，节目逐渐增多，几位高官大员也顾不得仪容，额上的官帽都歪斜了。

en.t: Everyone competed to display their best tricks, the feats grew more and more varied, and even several high-ranking nobles forgot their decorum, their court caps tilting crookedly on their brows.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将想起自己官位的高贵，觉得今天举止如此粗暴，实在是破例了。

en.t: General Yugiri remembered the dignity of his rank and felt that behaving so roughly today was truly exceptional.

units.source_text: 然而一眼望去，他还是显得比别人更加年轻，更加俊美。

en.t: Even so, at a glance he still appeared younger and more handsome than anyone else.

units.source_text: 他身穿一件稍稍柔软的白面红里的常礼服，裙子的裾有点膨胀，略微拉起些，却并无轻率之相。

en.t: He wore a slightly soft formal robe with a white outer face and red lining; the skirt billowed a little and was drawn up slightly, yet there was nothing careless about his appearance.

units.source_text: 樱花像雪一般飘下来，落在他那清秀而落拓不羁的身子上。

en.t: Cherry blossoms drifted down like snow and fell upon his refined, free-spirited figure.

units.source_text: 他仰望樱花，把枯枝略微折断些，便坐在台阶中央休息。

en.t: He looked up at the cherry blossoms, snapped off a little of a dead branch, and then sat down in the middle of the steps to rest.

units.source_text: 柏木卫门督跟着来了，说道：“这花零落得好厉害啊！但愿春风‘回避樱花枝’才好。”

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, followed him and said, "The blossoms are falling terribly fast. If only the spring wind would spare the cherry branches."

units.source_text: 一面用眼梢向三公主那方面窥看。

en.t: As he spoke, he stole a sideways glance toward the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 三公主的房间一向关闭不甚严密，侍女们各色各样的襟袖露出在帘子底下，帘内显出参差人影，好比暮春旅途上供献路神的币袋。

en.t: The Third Princess's room was never very tightly closed off; the attendants' collars and sleeves of many colors showed beneath the blinds, and uneven shadows of people appeared within, like offering pouches set out to roadside gods on a late-spring journey.

units.source_text: 室内帷屏等胡乱地拉在一边，似觉内外无间，声气相通。

en.t: Curtains and screens inside had been pulled carelessly aside, so that inside and outside seemed almost unseparated, with voices and movement passing freely between them.

units.source_text: 这时候有一只可爱的中国产小猫，被较大的猫所追逐，突然从帘子底下逃出来。

en.t: Just then, a charming little Chinese cat, chased by a larger cat, suddenly escaped out from under the blind.

units.source_text: 侍女们慌张了，喧哗扰攘，东奔西走，衣声足音，历历可闻。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting panicked, crying out and bustling about, rushing here and there, while the rustle of their robes and the sound of their footsteps could be heard clearly.

units.source_text: 那小猫大约还没有养驯，所以身上系着一根长长的绳子，这绳子被东西绊住，缠得很紧。

en.t: The kitten had probably not yet been tamed, so a long cord was tied to it, and this cord had caught on something and become tightly tangled.

units.source_text: 那小猫想逃，拼命拖这绳子，便把帘子的一端高高地掀起，并没有人立刻来整理。

en.t: Trying to flee, the kitten dragged desperately at the cord and lifted one end of the blind high up, but no one immediately came to put it back in order.

units.source_text: 这里柱子旁边的侍女们一时心慌意乱，只觉得手足无措。

en.t: The attendants beside the pillar there were thrown into confusion for a moment and could only stand helplessly at a loss.

units.source_text: 柏木望见帷屏旁边稍进深的地方，站着一个贵妇人打扮的女子。

en.t: Kashiwagi saw, in a slightly recessed place beside the curtains and screens, a woman standing there dressed like a noble lady.

units.source_text: 这地方是台阶西面第二间屋子的东隅，所以从柏木所在之处望去，毫无阻隔，可以看得清清楚楚。

en.t: This was the eastern corner of the second room west of the steps, so from where Kashiwagi stood there was nothing to block his view, and he could see it all quite clearly.

units.source_text: 但见她穿的大约是红面紫里的层层重叠的衣服，有浓有淡，好像用彩色纸订成的册子的横断面。

en.t: He saw that she seemed to be wearing layer upon layer of robes with red outer faces and purple linings, some deep in color and some pale, like the cut edge of a booklet bound from colored paper.

units.source_text: 外面披的是白面红里的常礼服。

en.t: Over them she wore a formal robe with a white outer face and red lining.

units.source_text: 头发光艳可鉴，冉冉下垂，直达衣裾，好像一绺青丝。

en.t: Her hair shone so richly it seemed mirror-bright, falling softly down to the hem of her robes like a single stream of black silk.

units.source_text: 末端修剪得非常美观，比身子长约七八寸。

en.t: The ends were trimmed very beautifully and reached about seven or eight inches beyond her body.

units.source_text: 她的身材十分纤小，衣裾挂得很长。

en.t: Her figure was extremely slender, and the hems of her robes trailed long around her.

units.source_text: 这垂发的侧面姿态，美丽不可言喻。

en.t: The side view of her with her hair hanging down was beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 只是日色已暮，室中幽暗，不曾看得分明，颇有未能餍足之憾。

en.t: But the day was already fading and the room was dim, so he could not see her clearly, leaving him with a deep sense of unsatisfied longing.

units.source_text: 此时许多青年公子正在热衷于蹴鞠，连撞落樱花也顾不得。

en.t: At this time many young noblemen were absorbed in kemari, not even caring when they knocked down the cherry blossoms.

units.source_text: 众侍女看得出神，也顾不得外间有人窥看了。

en.t: The attendants were watching in such fascination that they no longer noticed that someone outside might be peering in.

units.source_text: 那小猫大声哀鸣，那人回眸一顾，刹那间显出了风韵娴雅的青年美女的姿态。

en.t: When the kitten cried out loudly and pitifully, the woman turned her head to look back, and for an instant she revealed the bearing of a graceful and refined young beauty.

units.source_text: 夕雾见此光景，心中深感不安，但倘亲自走近去把帘子放下，又觉过于轻率，只得咳嗽几声，促使那人注意。

en.t: Seeing this, Yugiri felt deeply uneasy, but since it would seem too forward to go over himself and lower the blind, he could only cough a few times to draw her attention.

units.source_text: 那人便退到里面去了。

en.t: She then withdrew farther inside.

units.source_text: 夕雾虽然如此好心，自己也觉不曾看饱。

en.t: Although Yugiri had acted out of kindness, he too felt that he had not seen enough.

units.source_text: 但此时小猫已经摆脱绳子，帘子放下了，他就不知不觉地叹息一声。

en.t: By then, however, the kitten had already freed itself from the cord and the blind had fallen back down, and he unconsciously let out a sigh.

units.source_text: 何况那个刻骨相思的柏木，此时但觉愁绪满胸。

en.t: How much more, then, did Kashiwagi, whose love had pierced him to the bone, feel his breast filled with sorrow at that moment.

units.source_text: 他想：“那人到底是谁呢？许多女子之中，只有这个人触目地作贵妇人装束。

en.t: He thought, "Who could that woman be? Among all those women, only she stood out in the dress of a noble lady.

units.source_text: 如此看来，那人定然是三公主，决不会有误了。”

en.t: Seen in that light, she must surely be the Third Princess; there can be no mistake."

units.source_text: 这面影便长留在他心头。

en.t: That image remained long in his heart.

units.source_text: 当时他装作若无其事，但夕雾知道他已经窥见娇容，不免替三公主惋惜。

en.t: At the time he pretended that nothing had happened, but Yugiri knew he had glimpsed her lovely face and could not help feeling sorry for the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 柏木无可奈何，为欲聊以自慰，把那小猫呼过来，抱在怀里，但觉猫身上染着公主的浓烈的衣香。

en.t: Kashiwagi, helpless and seeking at least a little comfort, called the kitten over and held it in his arms, feeling that its body was steeped in the princess's rich robe fragrance.

units.source_text: 听了那娇嫩的叫声，就把它比拟作三公主，觉得异常可爱。

en.t: Hearing its delicate cry, he likened it to the Third Princess and found it extraordinarily dear.

units.source_text: 真是个色情儿啊！

en.t: He truly was a man of amorous passions.
